baslik_html: Gemini Desktop tests full Mac access
alt_satir: A hidden setting lets it act on any file without asking.
gorsel_html:
What is it?

TestingCatalog spotted a hidden setting in the Gemini Desktop app on Oct 2, reported Oct 3. Enabling it lets Gemini read, modify or delete files anywhere on the Mac, outside connected folders, and act through Mail or Safari without asking first.

  • VendorGoogle, Gemini Desktop
  • What changed"Additional sandbox options"
  • AffectedmacOS users, managed fleets
  • AvailabilityNot live, unconfirmed

How it works

  1. Now: only folders you connect, ask first.
  2. Toggle grants standing consent instead.
  3. Files anywhere, plus Mail and Safari.
  4. Money, accounts, legal terms still ask.

What the setting says (quoted)

# Gemini Desktop, in-app text
"...take actions without asking
for your permission first"
"...delete files anywhere"
"...perform actions through them"

Check it today

# apps holding Full Disk Access
$ sudo sqlite3 /Library/Application\
    Support/com.apple.TCC/TCC.db \
    'select client,service from access'
Reading TCC.db needs Full Disk Access itself.

How to defend

  • Set the policy before the toggle ships.
  • Deny Full Disk Access by MDM, app by app.
  • Lock Automation for Mail and Safari.
  • Watch outbound mail from desktop agents.
Four actions still ask. Reading every file does not.
